# Weekly Deep Dive — week ending Sunday, 18 October 2026

**The week in one line:** Soaring crude oil and persistent bond yields hammered US tech shares, while autonomous AI agents reshaped junior engineering and pushed financial institutions to lock down account security.

## 🚨 The 5 stories that mattered most

1. 🟡 DEVELOPING **Global crude oil tests $110 as Persian Gulf tensions and Russian refinery strikes escalate**: Brent crude climbed toward $109.86 per barrel after drone strikes hit a major fuel terminal in Saint Petersburg and maritime attacks near the Strait of Hormuz shut down commercial tanker traffic. With global diesel refining tightened and maritime shipping halted, energy costs spiked across major economies [[Al Jazeera]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[France 24]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPUWJST3kyUkpMcDg2V01NODZWOXIwUy1JbHpSQWpuUVluTERtZ1BjR0NKMGhhVHVfX1NpelF6SDJ6TEJXbk93cWpmU0JubGs1REgwZGFSOVRiNV94SFEyT3pHMGpVUUVJMUhSZWVaLUstV183RzFORy1TSVl5U1ZIa2NxcnZnLU9LelNqWGdfXzhpOFotS2ZDenhkX2NVOVdESnI5RTdlSTJqZ25uUjFycF9yMndwRVFmdDVkbA?oc=5). *Why it matters:* Persistent energy inflation keeps US Treasury yields above 5%, dampening equity markets and raising living costs.

2. 🟡 DEVELOPING **AI agents spark a structural collapse in junior software hiring**: Anthropic revealed that junior technical headcount plummeted to 9% as internal autonomous coding agents now deliver six times the workload of entry-level developers [[ANI News]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxQVXNqRlFjYmM3cmZYRENhTG5teWxZNWJPZHp1M0tYMmJUcnhtNGRUUGJGeFNmSmVnUDItVnNwRlFsbzJsb1hqRXRKR2JKUG9ieVBVNHlKRmdCeXctMjVUMU91Vm55cW1PelpzZTNwUy0wLWtXYWR2eG9STVlyZWdmV1JWbWNkVkE3dXlaYklOWkhHdWdFODVUYTZNTHJ4dWp1aTEtanIwa3E5R044UWZSSkpSQXgxdEtZUWlNWlRLV0tJTjk1VFdCWTZZcWs?oc=5). Traditional enterprise hiring models are dissolving as organizations swap basic manual coding for automated pipelines and agent evaluation [[The Decoder]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxQbUVIR3B0ZWU0ZVFwZW1nZFU2d2dWUmppM19zNDh4TjctNFFxN3hnZWMtTm9FVXdYVVpOOEFCeXNONk5FR3ZXb2h0T0pKVTBmX3NnTHFEVjVYTDJPcUdfYkRLUWoyeGNIWFlSM2p2QUtYS0N0NUFiSFJmb3J2VUk3S1pBS3FMMFNneTc0ZWlQb2YtbUViSjRZZW95OXJCbWhvd19jTzN0UUZqUHlLT1l6QlMyMlEtM18wMnZ1WURCazhyQQ?oc=5). *Why it matters:* Data and MLOps engineers must transition immediately from manual feature coding to agent orchestration, prompt verification, and system security.

3. ⚖️ COURT DEVELOPMENT & 🟡 DEVELOPING **US immigration policy whipsaws between court battles and administrative tightening**: The Trump administration appealed a federal injunction that blocked its controversial $100,000 H-1B fee, while DHS advanced proposals to end automatic deference for visa renewal extensions and ended 540-day automatic work permit (EAD) extensions [[The Economic Times]](https://news.google._?oc=5). Vice President JD Vance walked back calling H-1B holders "indentured servants" following Indian diplomatic objections, but regulatory scrutiny continues to expand [[The New Indian Express]](https://news.google.?oc=5). *Why it matters:* Indian tech professionals in the US face longer documentation timelines, higher scrutiny on extensions, and an imperative to plan PR alternatives.

4. 🟡 DEVELOPING **RBI drains $8.58 billion in forex reserves to stabilize the rupee at 94.95**: India’s central bank sold dollars aggressively as foreign institutional investors pulled ₹52,100 crore from domestic equities amid high global energy prices [[Business Standard]](https://news.google.?oc=5). The defense succeeded in capping rupee depreciation near ₹94.95, keeping foreign reserves robust at $726.03 billion despite steep crude import bills [[The Sunday Guardian]](https://news.google.?oc=5). *Why it matters:* Remittance exchange rates remain highly favourable for NRIs sending money home, while imported inflation stays under active check.

5. ✅ CONFIRMED & 🟡 DEVELOPING **US financial giants block external AI agents following security alarms**: JPMorgan Chase and Citigroup cut off external autonomous AI software agents from logging into retail and corporate accounts after detecting unauthorized payment runs [[NDTV Profit]](https://news.google.?oc=5). This mirrors a cyber advisory from India's CERT-In regarding rogue agent intrusions inside corporate networks, forcing developers toward zero-knowledge verification and zero-trust API frameworks. *Why it matters:* Autonomous AI workflows will be sharply constrained by compliance and security barriers until banks establish standardized machine-to-machine authentication protocols.

## 🧠 The big picture

- **AI workflow shift from talk to real replacement:** Anthropic's entry-level technical headcount collapsing to single digits marks a permanent realignment in engineering budgets. Real capital is being redirected from human junior developers toward automated agent pipelines. Momentum is accelerating; we would only change our mind if enterprise agent error rates cause large companies to revert back to junior human cohorts [[ANI News]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxQVXNqRlFjYmM3cmZYRENhTG5teWxZNWJPZHp1M0tYMmJUcnhtNGRUUGJGeFNmSmVnUDItVnNwRlFsbzJsb1hqRXRKR2JKUG9ieVBVNHlKRmdCeXctMjVUMU91Vm55cW1PelpzZTNwUy0wLWtXYWR2eG9STVlyZWdmV1JWbWNkVkE3dXlaYklOWkhHdWdFODVUYTZNTHJ4dWp1aTEtanIwa3E5R044UWZSSkpSQXgxdEtZUWlNWlRLV0tJTjk1VFdCWTZZcWs?oc=5).
- **Physical energy shocks vs financial assets:** Escalating physical disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz and strikes on Russian refineries demonstrate that physical commodities still dictate macro conditions. Momentum in oil prices is growing, preventing central banks from easing rates. We would reconsider this dynamic only if diplomacy quickly restores unhindered Hormuz passage and halts refinery strikes [[Reuters]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxOWUh3Z1JyMmU4SkJ4ZXQ4Y0VaN3RMS1Vtcmg4S1lDMGlvUG1GeVY3Q1pkaWltSG5yOWhmcTBnNkk4U0ZiTVREVzd3RVRZNjZJTjhaTkg5bTFGX0J2Q0JzTUI4UlZIWmxHMmRDeVRRODZRYU1mbkNrVzFRX3piTnpDbllfUGc3NnJkSl9hWWRCQzlxZjFBYnE5bXJQMVBjMzNBUFlNcmRtcw?oc=5).
- **Green tech and supply chain nationalism:** China's proposal to restrict exports of solar equipment proves that energy transition hardware is following the same national security playbook as advanced microchips. Momentum is growing as nations subsidize regional manufacturing to eliminate single-nation chokepoints [[The Hindu]](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/china-proposes-export-controls-on-12-solar-manufacturing-technologies/article71599338.ece).
- **What people may be missing:** While public political debate focuses on visa caps and rhetoric, administrative friction—such as removing automatic EAD extensions and tightening extension scrutiny—quietly poses a larger day-to-day disruption to foreign professionals than formal legislative changes [[Center for Immigration Studies]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPTjc0b29nWFQ3SHhYUkFGajJxbVRDWE1tenoyRUtoYjNYTXpPUE5CaGlmaURRUV9ZSEthLUEwR2p2QVpLTjhqOW80Q1YxN29waTJKcVh2YS1xUWRlaGw2aE9jNmJySTEwdlRQbVluTUNJUlNUUGtGU0hPSmF0OG1pMzMxQ0V3ekRMbXJhaUNXVDU0dlNJZWc?oc=5).

  **Verdict:** ❌ FALSE.
  **Evidence:** The actor's family and major news organizations confirmed that the death announcements circulating on social media were completely unfounded hoaxes [[The Times of India]](https://news.google.-?oc=5).
- **Claim:** The Indian government finalized the private sale of Bhilai Steel Plant to the Adani Group.
  **Verdict:** ❌ FALSE.
  **Evidence:** Steel Authority of India and factory administrators formally confirmed that viral claims of a private buyout are false and baseless [[The Economic Times]](https://news.google.?oc=5).

### 🎓 This week's lesson
**What is a Closing Auction Session (CAS) in stock exchanges?**
Most equity trading occurs continuously throughout the day as buy and sell orders match in real time. However, large institutional orders placed in the final moments of trading can trigger steep, artificial volatility. To prevent manipulation, stock exchanges conduct a **Closing Auction Session (CAS)** during the final 15 to 30 minutes of the session [[News On AIR]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxQczc4Sm1HVEFYVF9oR2djUnRHMmdKaFdfanh1NmlNMTJ6RGdpODlfLWx4YTlGZExUQjhzOFdRQ0E2YVY0OGY4WE0xYVV5Wkx2djVpT2V4VDhtczVSQ3pwN05vWGNKdkJhLWM0OWhSMVRTRkxRanhoNUR1cGtucFBnM3lEZzdYTWs3R2c1N1JoWktIN05nMXYtcE1pSEpZWVls?oc=5). During this special auction window, buy and sell orders are gathered without instantly filling. An automated exchange algorithm then computes the single clearing price where the highest volume of trades can settle. That clearing price becomes the market's official daily closing price.
